fixed_asset_opening_consistent.name: fixed_asset_opening_consistent
fixed_asset_opening_consistent.value: ("fixed_assets"."opening_depreciation" = 0 AND "fixed_assets"."opening_depreciation_through_month" IS NULL) OR ("fixed_assets"."opening_depreciation" > 0 AND "fixed_assets"."opening_depreciation_through_month" IS NOT NULL)

fixed_asset_disposal_consistent.name: fixed_asset_disposal_consistent
fixed_asset_disposal_consistent.value: ("fixed_assets"."status" = 'disposed') = ("fixed_assets"."disposal_date" IS NOT NULL AND "fixed_assets"."disposal_type" IS NOT NULL AND "fixed_assets"."disposal_verification_id" IS NOT NULL) AND COALESCE("fixed_assets"."disposal_type" = 'sale', false) = ("fixed_assets"."disposal_price" IS NOT NULL)

year_end_inventory_consistent.name: year_end_inventory_consistent
year_end_inventory_consistent.value: ("year_end_closings"."inventory_booked_at" IS NULL) = ("year_end_closings"."inventory_method" IS NULL) AND ("year_end_closings"."inventory_booked_at" IS NULL) = ("year_end_closings"."inventory_value" IS NULL) AND ("year_end_closings"."inventory_verification_id" IS NULL OR "year_end_closings"."inventory_booked_at" IS NOT NULL)

year_end_accruals_pair.name: year_end_accruals_pair
year_end_accruals_pair.value: ("year_end_closings"."accruals_verification_id" IS NULL) = ("year_end_closings"."accruals_reversal_verification_id" IS NULL) AND ("year_end_closings"."accruals_verification_id" IS NULL OR "year_end_closings"."accruals_booked_at" IS NOT NULL)

mo_operations_plan_weeks.name: mo_operations_plan_weeks
mo_operations_plan_weeks.value: ("mo_operations"."planned_start_week" is null) = ("mo_operations"."planned_end_week" is null) and ("mo_operations"."planned_start_week" is null or ("mo_operations"."planned_start_week" <= "mo_operations"."planned_end_week" and extract(isodow from "mo_operations"."planned_start_week") = 1 and extract(isodow from "mo_operations"."planned_end_week") = 1))

supplier_payments_item_live.name: supplier_payments_item_live
supplier_payments_item_live.where: "supplier_payments"."cancelled_at" is null and "supplier_payments"."payment_batch_item_id" is not null

supplier_payments_entry_live.name: supplier_payments_entry_live
supplier_payments_entry_live.where: "supplier_payments"."cancelled_at" is null and "supplier_payments"."bank_file_entry_id" is not null

suppliers_payment_method_details.name: suppliers_payment_method_details
suppliers_payment_method_details.value:
"suppliers"."payment_method" is null
      or ("suppliers"."payment_method" = 'bankgiro' and "suppliers"."bankgiro" is not null)
      or ("suppliers"."payment_method" = 'plusgiro' and "suppliers"."plusgiro" is not null)
      or ("suppliers"."payment_method" = 'bank_account' and "suppliers"."bank_clearing" is not null and "suppliers"."bank_account_number" is not null)
      or ("suppliers"."payment_method" = 'iban' and "suppliers"."iban" is not null)

customer_payments_entry_live.name: customer_payments_entry_live
customer_payments_entry_live.where: "customer_payments"."cancelled_at" is null and "customer_payments"."bank_file_entry_id" is not null

invoice_documents_kind.name: invoice_documents_kind
invoice_documents_kind.value: ("invoice_documents"."kind" = 'invoice' and "invoice_documents"."reminder_id" is null) or ("invoice_documents"."kind" = 'reminder' and "invoice_documents"."reminder_id" is not null)

configurator_groups_number_fields.name: configurator_groups_number_fields
configurator_groups_number_fields.value:
("configurator_groups"."kind" = 'number') = ("configurator_groups"."min_value" is not null and "configurator_groups"."max_value" is not null)
          and ("configurator_groups"."kind" = 'number' or ("configurator_groups"."unit" is null and "configurator_groups"."step" is null and "configurator_groups"."default_number" is null
               and "configurator_groups"."price_per_unit" = 0 and "configurator_groups"."price_base_value" = 0))

public.stock_balances.name: stock_balances
public.stock_balances.definition: select "article_id", "location_id", sum("quantity_delta") as "quantity_on_hand" from "stock_transactions" group by "stock_transactions"."article_id", "stock_transactions"."location_id"
